government.en: The government should provide free health care for all its citizens.
government.zh: 政府应该为所有公民提供免费医疗。

authority.en: The local authority is responsible for collecting household waste.
authority.zh: 地方当局负责收集生活垃圾。

administration.en: The new administration promised to spend more on public transport.
administration.zh: 新政府承诺在公共交通上投入更多资金。

policy.en: A policy of free public transport could reduce traffic in city centres.
policy.zh: 免费公共交通政策可以减少市中心的交通流量。

policymaker.en: Every policymaker should consider the long-term effects of new laws.
policymaker.zh: 每位决策者都应该考虑新法律的长期影响。

legislation.en: New legislation is needed to protect workers in the digital economy.
legislation.zh: 需要新的立法来保护数字经济中的工人。

legislate.en: Governments should legislate against the sale of unhealthy food in schools.
legislate.zh: 政府应该立法禁止在学校出售不健康食品。

regulation.en: Stricter regulation of the banks could prevent another financial crisis.
regulation.zh: 加强对银行的管理可以防止再次发生金融危机。

parliament.en: Parliament will vote on the proposed changes to the tax system next week.
parliament.zh: 议会下周将就税收制度的修改提案进行投票。

democracy.en: In a democracy, people have the right to choose their own leaders.
democracy.zh: 在民主国家,人民有权选择自己的领导人。

democratic.en: Free elections are the foundation of any democratic system.
democratic.zh: 自由选举是任何民主制度的基础。

election.en: Young people are less likely to vote in a national election.
election.zh: 年轻人在全国选举中投票的可能性较小。

vote.en: Some people believe that the age to vote should be lowered to sixteen.
vote.zh: 有些人认为投票年龄应该降低到十六岁。

political.en: Young people should take more interest in political issues.
political.zh: 年轻人应该更关注政治问题。

politician.en: A politician should be judged on actions rather than promises.
politician.zh: 评价政治家应该看行动,而不是承诺。

citizen.en: Every citizen has a duty to obey the law and pay tax.
citizen.zh: 每个公民都有义务遵守法律和纳税。

citizenship.en: Lessons in citizenship teach young people about their rights and duties.
citizenship.zh: 公民课教导年轻人了解自己的权利和义务。

civic.en: Voting is one of the most important civic duties in a democracy.
civic.zh: 投票是民主国家最重要的公民义务之一。

public-sector.en: Pay in the public sector is often lower than in private companies.
public-sector.zh: 公共部门的工资通常低于私营公司。

private-sector.en: The private sector can often provide these services more efficiently.
private-sector.zh: 私营部门往往能更高效地提供这些服务。

public-services.en: Higher taxes are needed to pay for better public services.
public-services.zh: 需要提高税收来支付更好的公共服务。

welfare.en: The welfare system should support people who are unable to work.
welfare.zh: 福利制度应该支持无法工作的人。

social-security.en: An ageing population puts increasing pressure on the social security system.
social-security.zh: 人口老龄化给社会保障体系带来越来越大的压力。

healthcare.en: Free healthcare should be available to everyone, regardless of income.
healthcare.zh: 无论收入如何,每个人都应该能享受免费医疗保健。

funding.en: Schools in poor areas should receive more funding from the government.
funding.zh: 贫困地区的学校应该从政府获得更多资金。

fund.en: Governments should fund research into cleaner forms of energy.
fund.zh: 政府应该资助清洁能源研究。

fund.en: A special fund has been created to help families who lost their homes.
fund.zh: 已设立专项基金帮助失去家园的家庭。

taxpayer.en: Every taxpayer has the right to know how public money is spent.
taxpayer.zh: 每位纳税人都有权知道公共资金的使用情况。

public-money.en: Public money should not be spent on art when hospitals need more staff.
public-money.zh: 医院还需要更多人手时,公共资金不应该花在艺术上。

priority.en: Improving public health should be the top priority of any government.
priority.zh: 改善公共卫生应该是任何政府的首要事项。

prioritise.en: Governments should prioritise education and health over military spending.
prioritise.zh: 政府应该优先考虑教育和医疗,而不是军费开支。

intervene.en: Governments should intervene when companies charge unfair prices.
intervene.zh: 当公司收取不公平的价格时,政府应该干预。

intervention.en: Early intervention can prevent small problems from becoming much more serious.
intervention.zh: 早期干预可以防止小问题发展得更严重。

enforce.en: Police must enforce the law fairly, whoever is involved.
enforce.zh: 无论涉及何人,警方都必须公正执法。

impose.en: The government could impose a tax on foods with a high sugar content.
impose.zh: 政府可以对高糖食品征税。

subsidise.en: Governments should subsidise public transport so that fares remain low.
subsidise.zh: 政府应该补贴公共交通,使票价保持在低水平。

invest-in.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy rather than coal and oil.
invest-in.zh: 政府应该投资于可再生能源,而不是煤炭和石油。

bureaucracy.en: Too much bureaucracy can make it difficult to start a small business.
bureaucracy.zh: 官僚主义过重可能使创办小企业变得困难。

corruption.en: Corruption takes money away from schools, hospitals and other public services.
corruption.zh: 腐败使学校、医院和其他公共服务失去资金。

transparency.en: Greater transparency would make the government more accountable to the public.
transparency.zh: 提高透明度将使政府对公众更负责任。

accountability.en: There should be more accountability in the way public money is spent.
accountability.zh: 公共资金的使用应该有更多问责。

reform.en: The education system is badly in need of reform.
Many people believe that the government must reform the prison system.
reform.zh: 许多人认为政府必须改革监狱制度。

initiative.en: The new initiative aims to reduce the amount of plastic used in schools.
initiative.zh: 这项新举措旨在减少学校的塑料用量。

campaign.en: A national campaign has helped to reduce the number of people who smoke.
campaign.zh: 一场全国性运动帮助减少了吸烟人数。

public-awareness.en: Governments should raise public awareness of the dangers of a poor diet.
public-awareness.zh: 政府应该提高公众对不良饮食危害的认识。

diplomacy.en: Diplomacy is always better than military action in solving international conflicts.
diplomacy.zh: 解决国际冲突时,外交总是好于军事行动。

sovereignty.en: Some people fear that globalisation reduces the sovereignty of smaller nations.
sovereignty.zh: 有些人担心全球化削弱小国的主权。

national-security.en: Governments sometimes limit personal freedom for reasons of national security.
national-security.zh: 政府有时出于国家安全的原因限制个人自由。

military.en: Some countries require young people to complete a period of military service.
military.zh: 有些国家要求年轻人服一段时间的兵役。

defence.en: Spending on defence takes money away from education and health.
defence.zh: 国防开支占用了教育和医疗的资金。

conflict.en: Conflict in the region has forced many families to leave their homes.
conflict.zh: 该地区的冲突迫使许多家庭离开家园。

refugee.en: Wealthy nations should do more to help each refugee build a new life.
refugee.zh: 富裕国家应该做更多的事,帮助每位难民开始新生活。

humanitarian.en: Humanitarian organisations provide food and medicine in areas affected by war.
humanitarian.zh: 人道主义组织在受战争影响的地区提供食物和药品。

aid.en: Foreign aid should be spent on projects that help people become independent.
aid.zh: 外国援助应该用于帮助人们实现自立的项目。

non-governmental-organisation.en: A non-governmental organisation can often respond quickly in an emergency.
non-governmental-organisation.zh: 非政府组织在紧急情况下往往能迅速作出反应。

legislator.en: Each legislator must balance the needs of different groups in society.
legislator.zh: 每位立法者都必须平衡社会不同群体的需求。

senate.en: The Senate rejected the proposal to raise the national minimum wage.
senate.zh: 参议院否决了提高全国最低工资的提案。

congress.en: Congress passed a new law to protect the country's national parks.
congress.zh: 国会通过了一项保护国家公园的新法律。

committee.en: A special committee was formed to study the causes of youth crime.
committee.zh: 成立了一个特别委员会来研究青少年犯罪的原因。

ballot.en: Citizens cast their ballot in secret to ensure a fair election.
ballot.zh: 公民以无记名方式投票,以确保选举公平。

ideology.en: Political ideology should not influence what is taught in schools.
ideology.zh: 政治意识形态不应影响学校教授的内容。

regime.en: The old regime was replaced after years of protests by ordinary people.
regime.zh: 经过普通民众多年的抗议,旧政权被取代了。

autonomy.en: Universities should have greater autonomy in deciding what they teach.
autonomy.zh: 大学在决定教学内容方面应该有更大的自主权。

privilege.en: Education should be a basic right rather than a privilege of the rich.
privilege.zh: 教育应该是基本权利,而不是富人的特权。

nationality.en: Discrimination based on nationality should not be allowed in the workplace.
nationality.zh: 工作场所不应允许基于国籍的歧视。

republican.en: The country adopted a republican system after the end of the monarchy.
republican.zh: 君主制结束后,这个国家采用了共和制度。

amendment.en: An amendment to the law now gives women equal rights to property.
amendment.zh: 法律的一项修正案现在赋予女性平等的财产权。

decree.en: The president issued a decree banning all public meetings.
decree.zh: 总统颁布法令,禁止一切公开集会。

veto.en: The president used his veto to stop the bill from becoming law.
veto.zh: 总统行使否决权,阻止这项法案成为法律。

ultimatum.en: The union gave the company an ultimatum over pay and working hours.
ultimatum.zh: 工会就工资和工时向公司发出了最后通牒。

dictatorial.en: A dictatorial government does not allow people to criticise its decisions.
dictatorial.zh: 独裁政府不允许人们批评它的决定。

authoritative.en: People need authoritative sources of information during a health crisis.
authoritative.zh: 在健康危机期间,人们需要权威的信息来源。

centralise.en: Some governments centralise power, leaving local leaders with little control.
centralise.zh: 一些政府把权力集中起来,使地方领导人几乎没有控制权。

govern.en: Leaders who govern fairly tend to win the trust of their people.
govern.zh: 公正治理的领导人往往能赢得人民的信任。

administer.en: The money is administered by a committee of local residents.
administer.zh: 这笔钱由当地居民组成的委员会管理。

confer.en: A university degree may confer certain advantages in the job market.
confer.zh: 大学学位可能在就业市场上带来某些优势。

entitle.en: A valid student card will entitle you to reduced prices on transport.
entitle.zh: 有效的学生证使你有权享受交通优惠。

empower.en: Education can empower women to make their own decisions.
empower.zh: 教育能使女性有能力自己作决定。

deport.en: The government has the power to deport foreign criminals after they serve their sentences.
deport.zh: 政府有权在外国罪犯服刑后将其驱逐出境。

armament.en: Too much public money is spent on armament rather than on schools.
armament.zh: 太多公共资金花在军备上,而不是学校上。

disarm.en: Many countries have agreed to disarm in order to reduce the risk of war.
disarm.zh: 许多国家同意裁军,以减少战争风险。

naval.en: The country's naval forces protect ships from attack in international waters.
naval.zh: 该国海军力量保护船只在国际水域免受袭击。

tactics.en: The police changed their tactics after criticism of the way they treated protesters.
tactics.zh: 警方因对待抗议者的方式受到批评,改变了策略。

morale.en: Low pay and long hours have damaged morale among nurses.
morale.zh: 低工资和长工时损害了护士的士气。

raid.en: Police arrested three men during a raid on the warehouse.
raid.zh: 警方在突袭仓库时逮捕了三名男子。

encroach.en: New housing developments continue to encroach on valuable farmland.
encroach.zh: 新的住房开发项目继续侵占宝贵的农田。

confidential.en: Medical records are confidential and should be protected by law.
confidential.zh: 病历是机密的,应受到法律保护。

clandestine.en: The group held clandestine meetings to plan their campaign against the government.
clandestine.zh: 这个团体秘密开会,策划反政府运动。

assembly.en: The national assembly voted to raise the school-leaving age.
assembly.zh: 国民议会投票决定提高离校年龄。

alliance.en: The two nations formed an alliance to protect their trade routes.
alliance.zh: 两国结成联盟,保护贸易路线。

missile.en: The development of a single missile can cost hundreds of millions of dollars.
missile.zh: 研发一枚导弹可能花费数亿美元。

consultation.en: The new rules were introduced without consultation with local residents.
consultation.zh: 新规定在没有与当地居民磋商的情况下出台了。

directive.en: A new directive requires all member states to reduce their waste.
directive.zh: 一项新指令要求所有成员国减少废物。

incumbent.en: The incumbent lost the election because of rising unemployment.
incumbent.zh: 由于失业率上升,现任者输掉了选举。

coalition.en: The two parties formed a coalition after neither won a majority.
coalition.zh: 两党都未获得多数席位,于是组成了联合政府。

federation.en: The country is a federation of several largely independent states.
federation.zh: 这个国家是由几个基本独立的州组成的联邦。

chancellor.en: The chancellor announced an increase in spending on schools and hospitals.
chancellor.zh: 财政大臣宣布增加对学校和医院的支出。

ambassador.en: The ambassador met local business leaders to discuss trade between the countries.
ambassador.zh: 大使会见了当地商界领袖,讨论两国贸易。

embassy.en: Visitors must apply for a visa at the embassy before they travel.
embassy.zh: 游客出行前必须到大使馆申请签证。

protest.en: Thousands of students joined the protest against higher university fees.
protest.zh: 数千名学生参加了反对提高大学学费的抗议。

protest.en: Local people protested against the plan to close the village school.
protest.zh: 当地人抗议关闭村校的计划。

rally.en: Thousands of people attended a rally to support the striking workers.
rally.zh: 数千人参加集会,支持罢工工人。

petition.en: More than ten thousand people signed a petition against the new airport.
petition.zh: 一万多人在反对新机场的请愿书上签了名。

unrest.en: High unemployment among young people can lead to social unrest.
unrest.zh: 年轻人失业率高可能导致社会动荡。

turmoil.en: The sudden fall in share prices caused turmoil in world markets.
turmoil.zh: 股价突然下跌造成了世界市场的混乱。

partisan.en: Partisan debate makes it difficult to reach agreement on important issues.
partisan.zh: 党派争论使重要问题难以达成一致。

ally.en: The country relied heavily on its closest ally for protection.
ally.zh: 这个国家严重依赖最亲密的盟友提供保护。

nominee.en: The president's nominee for the highest court was approved last week.
nominee.zh: 总统提名的最高法院人选上周获得批准。

nominate.en: Each party will nominate one candidate to stand for election.
nominate.zh: 每个政党将提名一名候选人参加竞选。

asylum.en: Many people seek asylum in order to escape war in their own countries.
asylum.zh: 许多人寻求庇护,以逃离本国的战争。

conspiracy.en: Many people still believe the conspiracy theories that spread on social media.
conspiracy.zh: 许多人仍然相信社交媒体上流传的阴谋论。

militant.en: Militant groups have attacked government buildings in the north of the country.
militant.zh: 好战团体袭击了该国北部的政府建筑。

bilateral.en: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement on trade and education.
bilateral.zh: 两国签署了一项关于贸易和教育的双边协议。

criminal.en: A convicted criminal may find it very difficult to get a job.
criminal.zh: 被定罪的罪犯可能很难找到工作。

criminal.en: Criminal behaviour among young people is often linked to poverty.
criminal.zh: 年轻人的犯罪行为常常与贫困有关。

offender.en: A young offender should receive education as well as punishment.
offender.zh: 青少年罪犯在接受惩罚的同时也应接受教育。

offence.en: Driving while using a mobile phone is a serious offence.
offence.zh: 开车时使用手机是一种严重的违法行为。

juvenile-delinquency.en: Lack of parental guidance is often seen as a cause of juvenile delinquency.
juvenile-delinquency.zh: 缺乏父母指导常被视为青少年犯罪的一个原因。

violent-crime.en: Violent crime is more common in areas with high unemployment.
violent-crime.zh: 暴力犯罪在失业率高的地区更为常见。

theft.en: Mobile phone theft has become a common problem in large cities.
theft.zh: 手机盗窃已成为大城市的常见问题。

burglary.en: Good street lighting can help to reduce burglary in residential areas.
burglary.zh: 良好的街道照明有助于减少住宅区的入室盗窃。

robbery.en: The man was sent to prison for his part in a bank robbery.
robbery.zh: 这名男子因参与银行抢劫被送进监狱。

fraud.en: Online fraud costs consumers millions of pounds every year.
fraud.zh: 网络欺诈每年使消费者损失数百万英镑。

murder.en: Some people believe that murder should be punished with life in prison.
murder.zh: 有些人认为谋杀应被判处终身监禁。

assault.en: He received a two-year sentence for assault on a police officer.
assault.zh: 他因袭击警察被判处两年徒刑。

vandalism.en: Young people with nothing to do may turn to vandalism.
vandalism.zh: 无所事事的年轻人可能转向故意破坏公物。

smuggling.en: Tighter border controls have reduced the smuggling of goods.
smuggling.zh: 更严格的边境管制减少了货物走私。

drug-trafficking.en: Drug trafficking is a serious crime that carries a long prison sentence.
drug-trafficking.zh: 贩毒是严重的犯罪,会被判处长期徒刑。

legal.en: People under the legal age should not be allowed to buy alcohol.
legal.zh: 未达到合法年龄的人不应被允许购买酒精饮料。

illegal.en: It is illegal to sell cigarettes to children in most countries.
illegal.zh: 在大多数国家,向儿童出售香烟是非法的。

lawyer.en: Everyone accused of a crime should have the right to a lawyer.
lawyer.zh: 每个被指控犯罪的人都应有权聘请律师。

solicitor.en: You should ask a solicitor for advice before signing the contract.
solicitor.zh: 签合同之前,你应该咨询律师。

attorney.en: The attorney argued that the evidence against his client was not reliable.
attorney.zh: 律师辩称,对他当事人不利的证据并不可靠。

judge.en: The judge decided that the company had broken the law.
judge.zh: 法官判定这家公司违反了法律。

jury.en: The jury found the man guilty after three days of discussion.
jury.zh: 陪审团经过三天讨论,认定该男子有罪。

court.en: The case will be heard in court at the end of next month.
court.zh: 这个案件将于下月底在法院审理。

sue.en: Customers may sue a company if its products cause them harm.
sue.zh: 如果产品对顾客造成伤害,顾客可以起诉公司。

prosecute.en: The police decided not to prosecute the driver because of a lack of evidence.
prosecute.zh: 由于证据不足,警方决定不起诉这名司机。

defendant.en: The defendant said that he had been at home when the crime took place.

plaintiff.en: The plaintiff claimed that the company had failed to protect its workers.
plaintiff.zh: 原告称公司未能保护其员工。

witness.en: A witness told the court that she had seen the man leave the shop.
witness.zh: 一名证人告诉法庭,她看到该男子离开了商店。

verdict.en: The verdict surprised many people who had followed the case closely.
verdict.zh: 这项判决令许多密切关注此案的人感到意外。

guilty.en: A person is considered innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
guilty.zh: 一个人在法庭证明有罪之前都被视为无罪。

innocent.en: Some innocent people have spent years in prison for crimes they did not commit.
innocent.zh: 一些无辜的人因未曾犯下的罪行在狱中度过多年。

convict.en: The court needs clear evidence to convict someone of a serious crime.
convict.zh: 法院需要明确的证据才能判定某人犯有重罪。

sentence.en: The judge gave the man a sentence of three years in prison.
sentence.zh: 法官判处该男子三年监禁。

sentence.en: Young offenders should not be sentenced to long periods in adult prisons.
sentence.zh: 青少年罪犯不应被判处在成人监狱长期服刑。

penalty.en: There should be a heavier penalty for driving after drinking alcohol.
penalty.zh: 酒后驾车应受到更重的惩罚。

death-penalty.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty in recent decades.
death-penalty.zh: 近几十年来,许多国家废除了死刑。

capital-punishment.en: Supporters of capital punishment argue that it prevents serious crime.
capital-punishment.zh: 死刑的支持者认为它能防止严重犯罪。

imprisonment.en: Long periods of imprisonment do not always reduce the rate of crime.
imprisonment.zh: 长期监禁并不总能降低犯罪率。

prison.en: Sending young people to prison may make them more likely to reoffend.
prison.zh: 把年轻人送进监狱可能使他们更容易再次犯罪。

jail.en: He spent five years in jail for stealing from the company.
jail.zh: 他因盗窃公司财物坐了五年牢。

prisoner.en: Every prisoner should have the chance to learn new skills for life after release.
prisoner.zh: 每个囚犯都应有机会学习新技能,为出狱后的生活做准备。

inmate.en: Each inmate in the prison is offered basic education and job training.
inmate.zh: 监狱里的每个囚犯都能接受基础教育和职业培训。

parole.en: He was released on parole after serving half of his sentence.
parole.zh: 他服完一半刑期后获得假释。

community-service.en: Community service may be better than prison for people who commit minor crimes.
community-service.zh: 对于轻微犯罪者,社区服务可能比监禁更好。

deter.en: Tougher punishments may deter young people from committing crime.
deter.zh: 更严厉的惩罚可能阻止年轻人犯罪。

deterrent.en: Some people believe that long prison sentences act as a deterrent.
deterrent.zh: 有些人认为长期徒刑能起到威慑作用。

rehabilitate.en: Prisons should try to rehabilitate offenders rather than simply punish them.
rehabilitate.zh: 监狱应该努力改造罪犯,而不只是惩罚他们。

reoffend.en: Prisoners who gain new skills are less likely to reoffend after release.
reoffend.zh: 掌握新技能的囚犯出狱后不太可能再次犯罪。

patrol.en: More officers should patrol the streets on foot to make residents feel safe.
patrol.zh: 应该有更多警察步行巡逻街道,让居民感到安全。

arrest.en: The police made an arrest within two days of the crime.
arrest.zh: 案发两天内,警方就实施了逮捕。

investigation.en: A police investigation found that the fire had been started deliberately.
investigation.zh: 警方调查发现这场火灾是人为纵火。

suspect.en: Police have questioned a suspect in connection with the robbery.
suspect.zh: 警方已就这起抢劫案询问了一名嫌疑人。

suspect.en: Many experts suspect that the real figures are far higher.
suspect.zh: 许多专家怀疑实际数字要高得多。

victim.en: The victim of a crime often needs emotional as well as practical support.
victim.zh: 犯罪受害者往往既需要实际帮助,也需要情感支持。

justice.en: Everyone should have equal access to justice, whatever their income.
justice.zh: 无论收入如何,每个人都应平等地获得司法保障。

comply-with.en: Companies that fail to comply with safety laws should face heavy fines.
comply-with.zh: 不遵守安全法规的公司应当面临高额罚款。

violate.en: Companies that violate environmental rules should be forced to pay for the damage.
violate.zh: 违反环境法规的公司应被迫赔偿损失。

law-abiding.en: Most law-abiding citizens support stronger action against serious crime.
law-abiding.zh: 大多数守法公民支持加强打击严重犯罪。

constitution.en: The country's constitution guarantees freedom of speech to all citizens.
constitution.zh: 该国宪法保障所有公民的言论自由。

clause.en: A clause in the contract allows the company to end the agreement early.
clause.zh: 合同中的一项条款允许公司提前终止协议。

enact.en: The government plans to enact a new law on data protection.
enact.zh: 政府计划制定一项关于数据保护的新法律。

legalise.en: Some countries have decided to legalise the use of cannabis for medical purposes.
legalise.zh: 一些国家决定把医用大麻合法化。

abolish.en: Some people believe that governments should abolish all school fees.
abolish.zh: 有些人认为政府应该废除所有学费。

invalidate.en: Any change to the document may invalidate the entire agreement.
invalidate.zh: 对文件的任何改动都可能使整个协议无效。

mandatory.en: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory for all passengers in the car.
mandatory.zh: 车内所有乘客都必须系安全带。

obligatory.en: Military service is no longer obligatory in many European countries.
obligatory.zh: 在许多欧洲国家,服兵役已不再是义务。

licensed.en: Only licensed doctors should be allowed to prescribe these drugs.
licensed.zh: 只有获得许可的医生才能开这些药。

forbid.en: Some countries forbid the use of mobile phones in schools.
forbid.zh: 一些国家禁止在学校使用手机。

obey.en: Children who learn to obey rules at home tend to behave better at school.
obey.zh: 在家学会遵守规矩的孩子在学校往往表现更好。

accuse.en: Critics accuse the government of ignoring the needs of rural communities.
accuse.zh: 批评者指控政府忽视农村社区的需求。

accusation.en: The minister has denied the accusation that he misused public money.
accusation.zh: 这位部长否认了他滥用公共资金的指控。

lawsuit.en: Several families filed a lawsuit against the company over the polluted water.
lawsuit.zh: 几个家庭就水污染问题对该公司提起诉讼。

indictment.en: The high rate of youth unemployment is an indictment of government policy.
indictment.zh: 青年失业率高是对政府政策的控诉。

impeach.en: Parliament voted to impeach the president after the corruption scandal.
impeach.zh: 腐败丑闻发生后,议会投票决定弹劾总统。

testify.en: Witnesses must testify in court if they are asked to do so.
testify.zh: 如果被要求,证人必须出庭作证。

testimony.en: Her testimony helped the jury to reach its final decision.
testimony.zh: 她的证词帮助陪审团作出了最终决定。

plead.en: The man decided to plead guilty in the hope of a shorter sentence.
plead.zh: 该男子决定认罪,希望获得较短的刑期。

defend.en: The lawyer agreed to defend the young man in court for free.
defend.zh: 律师同意在法庭上免费为这名年轻人辩护。

acquit.en: The jury decided to acquit the woman because the evidence was weak.
acquit.zh: 由于证据不足,陪审团决定宣判这名女子无罪。

arbitration.en: The two sides agreed to settle their dispute through arbitration.
arbitration.zh: 双方同意通过仲裁解决争端。

confiscate.en: Schools have the right to confiscate phones used during lessons.
confiscate.zh: 学校有权没收上课时使用的手机。

detain.en: Police can detain a suspect for up to twenty-four hours without charge.
detain.zh: 警方可以在不起诉的情况下拘留嫌疑人最多二十四小时。

interrogate.en: Officers are not allowed to interrogate children without an adult present.
interrogate.zh: 没有成年人在场,警察不得审问儿童。

oath.en: Doctors take an oath to protect the health of their patients.
oath.zh: 医生宣誓保护患者的健康。

pledge.en: The government made a pledge to reduce carbon emissions by half.
pledge.zh: 政府承诺把碳排放量减少一半。

heir.en: The heir to the family's fortune chose to give most of it away.
heir.zh: 这个家族财富的继承人选择把大部分捐出去。

indemnity.en: The company paid an indemnity to the workers who were injured.
indemnity.zh: 公司向受伤工人支付了赔偿。

impunity.en: Large companies should not be able to pollute rivers with impunity.
impunity.zh: 大公司不应污染河流而不受惩罚。

exempt.en: Small businesses are exempt from the new tax on waste.
exempt.zh: 小企业免缴新的垃圾税。

condone.en: Society should never condone violence against children in any form.
condone.zh: 社会绝不应纵容任何形式的针对儿童的暴力。

condemn.en: World leaders were quick to condemn the attack on the hospital.
condemn.zh: 世界各国领导人迅速谴责了对医院的袭击。

denounce.en: Human rights groups denounced the arrest of the journalists.
denounce.zh: 人权组织公开谴责了逮捕记者的行为。

complaint.en: The company received thousands of complaints about its poor service.
complaint.zh: 这家公司收到了数千份关于服务差的投诉。

offensive.en: Comments that are offensive to others should be removed from social media.
offensive.zh: 冒犯他人的评论应从社交媒体上删除。

liberate.en: Education can liberate people from poverty and limited opportunities.
liberate.zh: 教育能把人们从贫困和有限的机会中解放出来。

release.en: Prisoners need support in finding work after their release.
release.zh: 囚犯出狱后找工作需要帮助。

release.en: The government will release the full results of the survey next month.
release.zh: 政府将在下个月发布调查的全部结果。

flee.en: Millions of people have been forced to flee their homes because of war.
flee.zh: 数百万人因战争被迫逃离家园。

penal.en: The country's penal system should focus more on education and training.
penal.zh: 该国的刑罚制度应该更加注重教育和培训。

illicit.en: The illicit trade in wild animals threatens many rare species.
illicit.zh: 非法的野生动物贸易威胁着许多珍稀物种。

illegitimate.en: Protesters claimed that the new government was illegitimate after a false election.
illegitimate.zh: 抗议者称,虚假选举后产生的新政府是非法的。

wilful.en: The company was fined for the wilful destruction of the forest.
wilful.zh: 这家公司因故意破坏森林被罚款。

heinous.en: Those who commit heinous crimes should face the strictest punishment.
heinous.zh: 犯下极其恶劣罪行的人应受到最严厉的惩罚。

counterfeit.en: Counterfeit medicines are a serious danger to people in many poor countries.
counterfeit.zh: 伪造药品对许多贫穷国家的人构成严重危险。

blackmail.en: Criminals used stolen photographs to blackmail people on social media.
blackmail.zh: 犯罪分子利用盗取的照片在社交媒体上敲诈他人。

ransom.en: Hackers locked the hospital's computers and demanded a ransom.
ransom.zh: 黑客锁定了医院的电脑,并索要赎金。

pickpocket.en: A pickpocket can quickly steal a wallet in a crowded tourist area.
pickpocket.zh: 在拥挤的旅游区,扒手能迅速偷走钱包。

arson.en: Investigators believe that the fire at the school was a case of arson.
arson.zh: 调查人员认为学校的火灾是一起纵火案。

rape.en: Victims of rape often need long-term support as well as legal help.
rape.zh: 强奸受害者不仅需要法律帮助,往往还需要长期支持。

instigate.en: Some social media users try to instigate violence during public protests.
instigate.zh: 一些社交媒体用户试图在公众抗议期间煽动暴力。

lure.en: Criminals use false job offers to lure young people abroad.
lure.zh: 犯罪分子用虚假的工作机会诱骗年轻人出国。

abuse.en: Children who suffer abuse may have problems with relationships as adults.
abuse.zh: 遭受虐待的孩子成年后可能在人际关系上出现问题。

abuse.en: Some officials abuse their power to gain money for themselves.
abuse.zh: 一些官员滥用权力为自己谋取钱财。

hostility.en: Immigrants may face hostility in areas with high unemployment.
hostility.zh: 在失业率高的地区,移民可能面临敌意。

riot.en: A riot broke out in the city after the announcement of the new tax.
riot.zh: 新税公布后,这座城市爆发了暴乱。

recidivism.en: Education in prison can greatly reduce recidivism among young offenders.
recidivism.zh: 狱中教育可以大大减少青少年罪犯的累犯率。

commit-a-crime.en: Young people who commit a crime should not automatically go to prison.
commit-a-crime.zh: 犯罪的年轻人不应该自动被送进监狱。

break-the-law.en: Companies that break the law should pay heavy fines.
break-the-law.zh: 违法的公司应该支付高额罚款。

law-enforcement.en: Law enforcement agencies are working together to stop online crime.
law-enforcement.zh: 执法机构正在合作打击网络犯罪。

organised-crime.en: Organised crime often grows in places where the government is weak.
organised-crime.zh: 有组织犯罪往往在政府薄弱的地方滋生。

tax-evasion.en: Tax evasion costs governments billions of pounds in lost money every year.
tax-evasion.zh: 逃税每年使各国政府损失数十亿英镑。

child-abuse.en: Teachers are trained to recognise the signs of child abuse.
child-abuse.zh: 教师接受培训,学习识别虐待儿童的迹象。

death-sentence.en: The court's death sentence caused anger among human rights groups.
death-sentence.zh: 法院的死刑判决引起了人权组织的愤怒。

consent.en: Doctors must obtain a patient's consent before any operation.
consent.zh: 医生必须在任何手术前征得患者的同意。

consent.en: Parents must consent before their children can join the school trip.
consent.zh: 孩子参加学校旅行前,必须得到父母的同意。

bullet.en: The bullet missed the police officer and hit a car parked nearby.
bullet.zh: 子弹没有击中警察,而是打中了停在附近的一辆车。

legitimate.en: Criticising the government is a legitimate right in a free society.
legitimate.zh: 在自由社会,批评政府是一项合法的权利。

liable.en: Companies are liable for any injuries caused by their faulty products.
liable.zh: 公司要为其缺陷产品造成的任何伤害负法律责任。

thief.en: The thief was caught after a camera recorded his face.
thief.zh: 摄像头拍到了小偷的脸,他随后被抓获。

gang.en: Teenagers without jobs may be persuaded to join a criminal gang.
gang.zh: 没有工作的青少年可能被说服加入犯罪团伙。

killer.en: Heart disease remains the biggest killer in most developed countries.
killer.zh: 在大多数发达国家,心脏病仍然是头号杀手。

breach.en: The company's use of personal data was a clear breach of the law.
breach.zh: 该公司使用个人数据的做法明显违反了法律。

negligence.en: The hospital was found guilty of negligence after the patient's death.
negligence.zh: 患者死亡后,医院被判定有疏忽之责。

magistrate.en: The magistrate ordered the young man to pay a small fine.
magistrate.zh: 地方法官判令这名年轻人支付一小笔罚款。

hostage.en: The police managed to free the hostage after several hours of discussions.
hostage.zh: 经过几小时的谈判,警方成功解救了人质。

kidnap.en: The gang tried to kidnap the businessman for a large sum of money.
kidnap.zh: 这个团伙试图绑架这名商人,以索取巨款。

harassment.en: Companies should have clear rules to deal with harassment at work.
harassment.zh: 公司应该有明确的规定来处理工作中的骚扰。

judicial.en: An independent judicial system is essential for a fair society.
judicial.zh: 独立的司法体系对公平的社会至关重要。

cocaine.en: Police found a large amount of cocaine hidden in the ship.
cocaine.zh: 警方在船上发现了大量隐藏的可卡因。
